rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Dolly Parton
Exhibition name: Dolly Parton
rows.Origin:
Bred by Joseph F. Winchel (United States, 1984).
Introduced in United States by Conard-Pyle (Star Roses) as 'Dolly Parton'.
rows.Bloom: Orange or orange-red. Strong fragrance. 35 petals. Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, upright. Large, semi-glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: up to 5' (up to 150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Prefers dry climates. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Patents:

rows.Parentage:

rows.Notes: Dolly Parton was born on January 19, 1946.
